{{Quote|Almost in unison, we turned on those excluders. Shredder bats literally fell out of the sky as their senses got scrambled.|[[Homack]]|<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
The '''Excluder''' was a sonic device manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]]. A handheld device, they emitted waves of high frequency sound that warded off many creatures while at the same time being inaudible to [[Human/Legends|Human]] and many other alien [[Species/Legends|species]]' hearing. It did affect some species, however, such as [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. The Merr-Sonn Excluder had three settings, capable of creating a disruption field of 10, 20 or 40 meters, respectively.

A small group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], including [[Homack]], used excluders while on a mission to the planet [[Hethar]]. Four sentries heard [[shredder bat]]s approaching and used the devices to disrupt their senses, before killing the dangerous predators.
